**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User purchased Sony WH-1000XM4 wireless noise-cancelling headphones on February 3rd.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for music streaming service recommendations to make the most out of their new headphones.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tidal is a hi-fi music streaming service that offers lossless, high-fidelity audio (FLAC, 1411 kbps) for $19.99/month after a free trial.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Amazon Music HD streams at 24-bit/192 kHz and costs $14.99/month or $12.99/month for Prime members.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Deezer HiFi offers lossless audio (FLAC, 1411 kbps) for $14.99/month with a 30-day free trial.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Qobuz offers Hi-Res Audio (24-bit/192 kHz) for $14.99/month or $149.99/year with a 30-day free trial.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Apple Music offers high-quality audio (256 kbps AAC) for $9.99/month with a 3-month free trial.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] All mentioned services offer large music libraries, playlists, and discovery features.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hi-Res Audio is a term for audio files with higher resolution than standard CD quality (16-bit/44.1 kHz).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] FLAC is a specific audio format that compresses audio files without losing original data.
- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in both music and podcasts for their daily commute.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tidal has a limited podcast selection of around 10,000-20,000 podcasts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Amazon Music HD offers over 100,000 podcasts and integrates Audible audiobooks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Deezer HiFi has around 30,000-40,000 podcasts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Qobuz offers a small selection of podcasts, around 10,000-20,000 titles.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Apple Music has over 800,000 podcasts available.
- [PREFERENCE] User is a student and is looking for student discounts on music streaming services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tidal offers a 50% student discount, bringing the HiFi plan to $9.99/month.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Amazon Music HD offers a student plan for $4.99/month, including access to Hi-Res Audio.
